SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
GROUP BY team_long_name
HAVING AVG(chanceCreationPassing) < (SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) FROM Team_Attributes)
ORDER BY chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT Team.team_long_name
FROM `Match`
JOIN Team ON `Match`.away_team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
AND season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY Team.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE buildUpPlayPassingClass = 'Long' AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012';

SELECT (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND date = '2013-07-12') - (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND date = '2013-07-12') AS difference;

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN `Match` ON League.id = `Match`.league_id
WHERE `Match`.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY League.name
HAVING AVG(`Match`.home_team_goal) > AVG(`Match`.away_team_goal);

SELECT Team_Attributes.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
AND date BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT SUM(`Match`.away_team_goal)
FROM `Match`
JOIN Player_Attributes ON `Match`.away_team_api_id = Player_Attributes.team_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' 
AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe' AND buildUpPlayPassingClass = 'Short';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) 
AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT buildUpPlayPositioningClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag';

SELECT Team_Attributes.team_fifa_api_id, Team_Attributes.team_api_id, Team_Attributes.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN `Match` ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = `Match`.home_team_api_id OR Team_Attributes.team_api_id = `Match`.away_team_api_id
WHERE Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky';

SELECT Team_Attributes.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN `Match` ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = `Match`.home_team_api_id
WHERE Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassingClass = 'Short' AND `Match`.home_team_goal = 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Belgium') 
AND league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Belgium Jupiler League') 
AND SUBSTR(`date`, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT player_name, player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id, birthday, height, weight, overall_rating, potential, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate, defensive_work_rate, crossing, finishing, heading_accuracy, short_passing, volleys, dribbling, curve, free_kick_accuracy, long_passing, ball_control, acceleration, sprint_speed, agility, reactions, balance, shot_power, jumping, stamina, strength, long_shots, aggression, interceptions, positioning, vision, penalties, marking, standing_tackle, sliding_tackle, gk_diving, gk_handling, gk_kicking, gk_positioning, gk_reflexes, age
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE sprint_speed >= 97 AND YEAR(date) >= '2013' AND YEAR(date) <= '2015'

SELECT AVG(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS avg_build_up_play_speed
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian';

SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(away_team_goal) 
FROM `Match` 
JOIN Team ON `Match`.away_team_api_id = Team.team_api_id 
JOIN Country ON `Match`.country_id = Country.id 
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Parma' AND Country.name = 'Italy';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT date
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
ORDER BY crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND Player_Attributes.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT Player_Attributes.potential
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini' AND Player_Attributes.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT MAX(AVG(finishing)) AS highest_average_finishing_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
OR player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT AVG(t2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes t2
JOIN Player t1 ON t2.player_api_id = t1.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010' AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015' AND t1.height > 170;

SELECT Team_Attributes.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN `Match` ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = `Match`.home_team_api_id
WHERE Team_Attributes.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND `Match`.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(long_shots) AS average_long_shot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_fifa_api_id IN (
  SELECT player_fifa_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'
);

SELECT league_name
FROM League
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT league_id
  FROM `Match`
  WHERE season = '2008/2009'
  GROUP BY league_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
);

SELECT MAX(home_team_goal) AS highest_score
FROM `Match`
WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie')
AND country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Netherlands');

SELECT chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN `Match` ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = `Match`.home_team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle' AND `Match`.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Hull City' AND date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT Player.player_name, Player.birthday
FROM Player
WHERE Player.player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada')
ORDER BY Player.birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND Player_Attributes.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT Player_Attributes.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND strftime('%Y', Player_Attributes.date) = '2011';

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND date = '2012-02-22';

SELECT player_name, AVG(heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
GROUP BY player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT Player_Attributes.long_passing
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
ORDER BY Player.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND Player_Attributes.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT MAX(chanceCreationPassing) AS highest_chance_creation_passing, chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE team_long_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE finishing = 1
ORDER BY birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS "Highest Build Up Play Speed", team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE team_long_name IN (
    SELECT team_long_name
    FROM Team_Attributes
    JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
    GROUP BY team_long_name
    ORDER BY MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) DESC
    LIMIT 4
)
GROUP BY team_long_name
ORDER BY MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
JOIN Player_Attributes ON `Match`.home_player_1 = Player_Attributes.player_api_id 
WHERE Player_Attributes.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE balance = (
        SELECT MAX(balance)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE potential = 61
    )
    AND potential = 61
);

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id IN (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Doran'
);

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN `Match` m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team
JOIN `Match` ON Team.team_api_id = `Match`.away_team_api_id
WHERE away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM `Match`);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date,1,4) = '2010'
AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date,1,4) = '2010');

SELECT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Team ON Player.player_api_id = Team.team_api_id
JOIN Country ON Team.team_fifa_api_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT l.name
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT finishing, curve
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY weight DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT home_team_api_id
FROM `Match`
WHERE season = '2015/2016' AND SUBTRACT(home_team_goal, away_team_goal) < 0
GROUP BY home_team_api_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.league_id) AS matches_played
FROM League l
JOIN `Match` m ON l.id = m.league_id
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY matches_played DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT (COUNT(height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70) / COUNT(id)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80
AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN `Match` ON League.id = `Match`.league_id
WHERE `Match`.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY COUNT(`Match`.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE penalties = (SELECT MAX(penalties) FROM Player_Attributes)
ORDER BY penalties DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY birthday DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT l.name, SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS difference;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
);

SELECT p.birthday
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Germany';

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
ORDER BY player_api_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'David Wilson';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name, c.name AS country_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON p.player_api_id = ta.team_api_id
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN Country c ON t.team_fifa_api_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision >= 90;

SELECT Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT Country.name
FROM Country
JOIN Player ON Country.id = Player.country_id
GROUP BY Country.name
ORDER BY AVG(Player.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_name, MAX(height) AS tallest_height
FROM Player;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
ORDER BY height ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT sets.id
FROM sets
WHERE sets.type = 'commander'
ORDER BY sets.totalSetSize DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT cards.status
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE cards.artist = 'D. Alexander Gregory'
AND cards.faceName = 'Status'
AND cards.keywords = 'Legacy'
AND legalities.format = 'legacy'
AND cards.hasContentWarning = 1;

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation' AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT DISTINCT cards.artist
FROM cards
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE sets.mcmName = 'Coldsnap' AND cards.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid 
WHERE cards.rarity = 'rare' 
AND cards.originalType = 'Enchantment' 
AND cards.type = 'Enchantment' 
AND cards.types = 'Enchantment' 
AND cards.name = 'Abundance' 
AND cards.faceName = 'Status' 
AND legalities.status = 'Legal';

SELECT sets.id
FROM sets
JOIN cards ON sets.code = cards.setCode
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
JOIN set_translations ON sets.code = set_translations.setCode
WHERE sets.isForeignOnly = 0
AND cards.isFoilOnly = 1
AND foreign_data.language = 'Japanese'
AND set_translations.language = 'Japanese';

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN cards.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cards.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE sets.mcmName = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT c.uuid, l.status
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.originalType = 'Artifact'
AND c.type = 'Artifact'
AND c.types = 'Artifact'
AND c.side IS NULL
AND l.format = 'vintage';

SELECT (COUNT(hasContentWarning = 0) / COUNT(id)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE legalities.format = 'commander' AND legalities.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM sets 
WHERE block = 'Ice Age' 
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM set_translations 
    WHERE sets.code = set_translations.setCode 
    AND set_translations.language = 'Italian'
);

SELECT f.name
FROM foreign_data f
JOIN cards c ON f.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE f.language = 'Italian'
AND s.mcmName = 'Coldsnap'
AND c.convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM cards WHERE setCode = 'Coldsnap');

SELECT foreign_data.name
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
JOIN set_translations ON cards.setCode = set_translations.setCode
WHERE cards.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson'
AND foreign_data.language = 'French'
AND set_translations.language = 'French'
AND cards.type = 'Creature'
AND cards.types = 'Creature'
AND cards.layout = 'normal'
AND cards.borderColor = 'black';

SELECT 
  DIVIDE(SUM(isNonFoilOnly = 1), SUM(language = 'Japanese'))*100 AS percentage
FROM 
  cards
JOIN 
  foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
JOIN 
  set_translations ON cards.uuid = set_translations.uuid
WHERE 
  foreign_data.language = 'Japanese' AND set_translations.language = 'Japanese';

SELECT
  SUM(isOnlineOnly = 1) / SUM(language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)') * 100 AS percentage
FROM
  cards
WHERE
  language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)';

SELECT DISTINCT foreign_data.language
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE sets.mcmName = 'Archenemy' AND sets.code = 'ARC';

SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE st.language = 'Korean'
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st2
    WHERE st2.setCode = s.code
    AND st2.language = 'Japanese'
);

SELECT c.name, c.convertedManaCost
FROM cards c
WHERE c.name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper')
ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT set_translations.translation
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
JOIN set_translations ON cards.setCode = set_translations.setCode
WHERE cards.name = 'Tendo Ice Bridge'
AND foreign_data.language = 'French'
AND set_translations.language = 'French';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE sets.mcmName = 'Coldsnap' AND cards.convertedManaCost > 5 AND (cards.power = '*' OR cards.power IS NULL);

SELECT cards.id, cards.artist
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE legalities.format = 'commander' AND legalities.status = 'Legal' AND (cards.power = '*' OR cards.power IS NULL);

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN cards.convertedManaCost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN sets.name = 'Coldsnap' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE sets.name = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT cards.manaCost
FROM cards
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE cards.layout = 'normal'
AND sets.frameVersion = '2003'
AND cards.borderColor = 'black'
AND cards.availability = 'mtgo,paper';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards) AS percentage
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
JOIN set_translations ON cards.uuid = set_translations.uuid
WHERE foreign_data.language = 'Chinese Simplified'
AND set_translations.language = 'Chinese Simplified'
AND cards.isOnlineOnly = 1;

SELECT cards.name
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE cards.power IS NULL OR cards.power = '*'
AND legalities.promoTypes = 'arenaleague'
ORDER BY cards.name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist)
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
AND availability LIKE '%arena,mtgo%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sets.code)
FROM sets
JOIN set_translations ON sets.code = set_translations.setCode
WHERE set_translations.language = 'Italian' AND sets.baseSetSize < 10;

SELECT COUNT(language = 'Japanese') / COUNT(language) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
JOIN set_translations ON cards.uuid = set_translations.uuid
JOIN sets ON cards.uuid = sets.uuid
WHERE foreign_data.language = 'Japanese' AND sets.type = 'expansion';

SELECT (COUNT(fd.id) / COUNT(l.uuid)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'French' AND l.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT st.translation
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND st.language = 'Chinese Simplified';

SELECT f.text
FROM foreign_data f
JOIN cards c ON f.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND f.language = 'Italian';

SELECT sets.releaseDate
FROM sets
JOIN set_translations ON sets.code = set_translations.setCode
WHERE set_translations.translation = 'Ola de frío';

SELECT set_translations.translation
FROM set_translations
JOIN cards ON set_translations.setCode = cards.setCode
WHERE cards.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND set_translations.language = 'Italian';

SELECT cards.id, cards.name, cards.originalType, cards.type, cards.types, cards.borderColor, foreign_data.language
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
WHERE cards.originalType = 'Artifact' AND cards.type = 'Artifact' AND cards.types = 'Artifact' AND cards.borderColor = 'black';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid 
JOIN set_translations ON cards.setCode = set_translations.setCode 
WHERE cards.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' 
AND foreign_data.language = 'Korean' 
AND set_translations.language = 'Korean';

SELECT sets.baseSetSize
FROM sets
JOIN set_translations ON sets.code = set_translations.setCode
WHERE set_translations.translation = 'Rinascita di Alara';

SELECT legalities.format, GROUP_CONCAT(cards.name)
FROM legalities
JOIN cards ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
WHERE legalities.status = 'Banned'
GROUP BY legalities.format
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE set_translations.translation = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' 
AND cards.artist = 'Adam Rex';

SELECT foreign_data.flavorText
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
WHERE cards.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND foreign_data.language = 'Italian';
